lines: Lanka Divyabharathi, Promoter Group, sells shares in the offer for sale through the stock exchange.
Their own share count is not printed; the notice gives Up to 38,10,000 Equity Shares for all sellers together. The sale settled 208 days ago, after 21 Apr 2026.
Ask whether the proceeds from the April 2026 sale have been reviewed with them, and what they plan for those funds.
Unknown: this seller's own share count and proceeds, since the notice gives only the combined total.
